Many ports contacted: this phone reached at least 10 ports on one host within a minute. Discovery tools can do this too. Close unfamiliar apps and check whether the activity stops; review their access.
Connection burst: at least 100 flows began in 10 seconds. Downloads or busy apps can cause this. Pause recent activity and check which apps were running.
High UDP rate: a flow averaged at least 1,000 datagrams per second. Streaming or games can cause this. Pause them and check whether the activity stops.

Clear findings
IPv4/IPv6 TCP and UDP only. Encrypted content is not decrypted. Findings describe patterns, not proven intrusions. No automatic threat blocking. Other VPNs cannot run at the same time.

ARM uses Android’s VPN interface to inspect traffic metadata and forward connections directly from this phone. No remote VPN server or cloud analysis is used. Payloads are forwarded but never saved. Findings stay in memory until cleared or the app process exits. This replaces another active VPN. Unsupported protocols, including ping, may not work. Existing connections may reconnect when monitoring starts or stops. You can stop at any time. Monitoring needs a working Wi-Fi or mobile connection; network changes may require restarting it.
